intro: Convert days (d) to years (yr) accurately for age milestones, warranty durations, multi-year contracts, and scientific uptime logs. Based on the Gregorian calendar average of 365.2425 days per year (incorporating 97 leap days every 400 years), 1 day equals 0.00273791 years—just divide your total days by 365.2425. Use the calculator above or scan pre-computed spans from 1 day to 20,000 days in the lookup table below.
alsoWrittenAs: d to yr, day to year, days into years, calendar days to years
tableTitle: Days to Years Conversion Chart (1 d to 20,000 d)
tableSubtitle: Gregorian calendar year equivalents computed with yr = d ÷ 365.2425 (1 d = 0.00273791 yr).
tableRoundingNote: Computed using the Gregorian mean calendar year (1 yr = 365.2425 d = 31,556,952 s). Table results are rounded to 5 significant digits; for non-leap 365-day contracts or 366-day leap years, adjust accordingly.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Gregorian Year (365.2425 d) vs. Common Year (365 d) vs. Julian Year (365.25 d)
items: A standard common calendar year has 365 days and a leap year has 366 days, while the long-term Gregorian calendar averages 365.2425 days per year (and the astronomical Julian year uses 365.25 days exact).
For financial interest calculations (such as ACT/365 or 30/360 bank day-count conventions), check whether your contract specifies an exact 365-day divisor instead of the Gregorian 365.2425-day mean.

faqs.question: How many years are in 1 day?
faqs.answer: 1 day equals 0.00273791 Gregorian years (1 ÷ 365.2425), or about 0.00274 years.

faqs.question: How do I convert days to years?
faqs.answer: Divide the number of days by 365.2425 for Gregorian calendar averages (or by 365 for a single non-leap year). For example, 1,151 days ÷ 365.2425 = 3.15133 years.

faqs.question: Should I divide days by 365, 365.2425, or 366?
faqs.answer: Use 365 for a fixed non-leap year, 366 for a single leap year, and 365.2425 (the Gregorian mean) for multi-year spans so leap days are accurately accounted for.

faqs.question: What is 1,000 days in years?
faqs.answer: 1,000 days equals 2.73791 Gregorian years, or roughly 2 years and 9 months.
